name: motif_add_phoneme
description:
Author a phoneme. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use only if the orthography writes a sound that has no phoneme yet, or a rule needs it as output; otherwise add a spelling with compose-edit-phoneme. HermitCrab parses no word with an undefined phoneme (guide nasal-assimilation). Stages a phoneme with literal representations, including symbols such as parentheses and slash, and optional explicit feature values. Put case spellings of the same sound on that phoneme; use its created identity in natural classes or phonological rules. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-phoneme. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

representations.description: Explicit grapheme codes, such as ['a'] or ['sh', 'š'].

feature.description: Closed feature id in the phonological feature system.

value.description: Symbolic value belonging to that feature.

features.description: Closed phonological feature/value pairs; copy ids from motif_grammar.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
